presentations.more: The code in this `try` fails on input the sender controls, and this `catch` answers every failure with a server status. The sender is told the server broke, so they retry the same bad request; the operator investigates errors that are not theirs; and the real cause reaches nobody who can fix it. Answer a malformed request as a client error.
